title: She worked in silence. Now she shines. ✨
script: Nobody believed in her. They said she was too ambitious. Too loud. Too much. So she worked twice as hard. In silence. Without validation. Without applause. And now? The people who doubted her are watching her succeed. The best revenge is a life well lived.
